text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the location and nature of the abdominal pain you are experiencing?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent heart attack and the sudden onset of periumbilical pain followed by bloody stools, I am concerned about compromised blood flow to your intestines. REQUEST TEST: CT Angiography of the Abdomen and Pelvis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The CT findings confirm reduced blood flow to the mesenteric arteries, which is highly indicative of acute mesenteric ischemia. Given your recent myocardial infarction, this is likely due to an embolic event. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia
